#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <bitset>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

void appendMissing(string& sb, int a) {
    bitset<26> seen;
    int start = max(0, (int)sb.length() - a);
    for (int i = sb.length() - 1; i >= start; --i)
        seen.set(sb[i] - 'a');
    int op = a;
    for (int i = 0; i < 26 && op > 0; ++i) {
        if (seen[i]) continue;
        sb.push_back('a' + i);
        --op;
    }
}

void appendLast(string& sb, int b) {
    char ch = sb.back();
    sb.append(b, ch);
}

int main() {
    int a, b, l, r;
    cin >> a >> b >> l >> r;

    string fin;
    for (int i = 0; i < a; ++i)
        fin.push_back('a' + i);
    for (int i = 0; i < b; ++i)
        fin.push_back('a' + a - 1);

    int x = l % (a + b);
    if (x == 0) x = a + b;
    if (x > 1)
        fin.erase(0, x - 1);

    appendMissing(fin, a);
    appendLast(fin, b);
    appendMissing(fin, a);
    appendLast(fin, b);

    int endIdx = min(r - l, (int)fin.length() - 1);
    bool seen[26] = {false};
    int count = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= endIdx; ++i) {
        char c = fin[i];
        if (!seen[c - 'a']) {
            seen[c - 'a'] = true;
            ++count;
        }
    }
    cout << count << endl;

    return 0;
}
